human.reason: gates.repeatable true -> false. BG Wiki tags 5 of the 15 structurally identical Borghertz's Hands quests |Repeatable=Yes and the other 10 |Repeatable=af (= 'Yes, after Memory reset', i.e. an artifact-armour reset, not a repeatable quest). All 15 are one-shot AF1 gauntlet quests on the same giver (guslam) with a one-time armour reward and no repeat prose. quest/jeuno/52's reader already made this same call and flagged it header_repeatable_disagrees. Correcting the remaining four so the family is consistent; without this, 5 of 15 identical quests draw a blue '!' on Guslam after completion and 10 draw nothing. See AF-QUESTS-FINDING.md.

notes:
The header's Start is a ZONE, 'Walk of Echoes (S)', not a giver, so the start is recovered from bullet 2: the Ornate Door is the entity you select and it resolves. Note the (S) suffix is a wiki habit here -- there is no 'Walk of Echoes (S)' zone, only 'Walk of Echoes' (182), while the Shadowreign field zones really are separate ids and keep their (S). The three latent-energy points are an OR, not a set: you need ONE Breath of dawn. They are modelled as a group so all three draw at once, which is the behaviour a player wants, with the evidence on the LAST member so satisfying it lands the mark past the whole group rather than inside it. None of the three is named by the page -- Beaucedine's is called 'an unlabeled (blank) point of interest' -- so all three targets are null and only the zone and grid survive. 'Breath of dawn' will not resolve: the key-item table has more than one key item by that name and the resolver refuses to guess, so that evidence entry will be dropped and this ladder advances on the session latch alone. Bullets 7 to 10 are tactics, the reward list and the once-per-Earth-day cooldown, none of them steps; the '== Champion of the Dawn ==' heading is the previous quest's name used as a section title and the numbering runs straight through it. ADVERSARY (stage D): demoted high -> medium. Two things the reading pass got right in reasoning but that the ladder cannot actually deliver. First, 'Breath of dawn' was confirmed against resolve.lua and comes back 'key item name is not unique', so stage C will drop the only evidence entry in the quest and this ladder advances on the session latch alone -- a ladder nothing can observe is not a 'high'. Second, the Breath of dawn is granted identically at all three latent-energy points and is recorded on the LAST group member; hard rule 4 says to put a twice-granted item on the earlier step only. The reading pass's reason for the last member (land the mark past the whole group) is sound and moving it is outside this pass's powers, so it stands and the doubt is recorded here instead. Everything else re-checked and left alone: step order matches the page, each group member carries its own (S) zone, the '== Champion of the Dawn ==' heading really does not restart the numbering, 'Walk of Echoes (S)' confirmed not to resolve while 'Walk of Echoes' does, and bullets 7-10 are correctly not steps.
